MPA Enterprises Operations & People

Payroll & Benefits

MPA connects your business to full-service payroll, benefits, and HR. We help you figure out what your team needs and get you to the right coverage, so you can focus on running the business.

Payroll

Paychecks and direct deposit, tax filing, PTO and garnishment tracking, and clear reporting.

Employee Benefits

Medical, dental, vision, life and disability, 401(k), FSA and HSA, and COBRA.

HR Support

Dedicated HR guidance, onboarding and offboarding, handbooks, and an online management platform.

Risk & Compliance

Workers' comp, OSHA and loss-control support, wage-and-hour and state compliance, and unemployment claims.

Hiring & Talent

Recruiting, applicant tracking, background screening, and performance management.

Time & More

Time and attendance tracking, QuickBooks sync, and tax credits like the Work Opportunity Tax Credit.
